correctness.rationale: The shared-hub invariant (n+1)-dimensional Jacobi matrix is cyclic and has squared couplings 2n and (r+1)(n-r). A rank-one comparison with the hypercube squared odd-shell block places its smallest squared positive frequency in (1,2) for odd n>=3 and (4,6) for even n>=4. Exact return forces all positive squared frequencies to be rational and hence integral by the monic integer characteristic polynomial. Even-dimensional polynomial coefficients are even, excluding the only candidate integer 5. The two low-dimensional return times follow from their full hub spectral supports. Full-graph and symbolic checks independently agree, but finite tests do not stand in for the dimension-uniform proof.
